VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 72 tests pass, satisfying criterion (2). However, there is no evidence that criterion (1)—the off-by-one bug actually being fixed—is met. Passing tests only demonstrate the bug is fixed if a test specifically exercises the off-by-one boundary condition. The evidence provided does not establish that such a regression/coverage test exists, so the bug-fix claim rests only on the self-report (SELF), which is insufficient.
